verdict.rationale: Simular documents a real Sai API: send a task (POST /v1/agents/message), stream progress (GET /v1/agents/events) and answer approvals (POST /v1/agents/approve), plus a Python SDK and an MCP server, so the core task-run loop is programmable. Nothing shows the many UI-side features are reachable through the API: scheduling, saved workflows, skills, marketplace workflows, BYOD device management and settings. The OpenAPI probe found no published spec. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of scheduling, saved workflow/skill management, marketplace and device/account settings, a published OpenAPI spec or explicit parity statement, and independent hands-on corroboration.
